A clean preflight exposed an inherited test comparing evolving current consumer bytes with immutable 0.2 qualifier hashes; maintained byte-exact historical fixtures preserve the unchanged production audit and mutation refusals without Git-history/network requirements. title: Explicit hosted canonical trace preparation precedes coherent qualification
